notes: Image notices on the title screen before login (one or more in a row). The anchor is the 'do not show today' checkbox at the bottom left (text, per language).

Closed with 'do not show today' (bottom left), which also keeps that notice away for the rest of the day. The box is translucent, so this anchor fails on some banner art; the start-up tap on the title screen presses the same box (pages/main_menu.json, enter.screens).
